vendoring:
  url: https://github.com/randombit/botan
  source-hosting: github
  tracking: tag

  skip-vendoring-steps:
    - hg-add
    - spurious-check
    - update-moz-build

  keep:
    - botan.mozbuild
    - botan_configure.py
    - moz.build
    - Makefile.in

  exclude:
    - ".*"
    - ".github/**"
    - "src/examples"

  update-actions:
    - action: replace-in-file-regex
      file: '{yaml_dir}/../README.botan'
      pattern: '\[tag [0-9\.]+\]'
      with: '[tag {revision}]'
